content: In Ephesians, Paul says we have been saved by what, through faith?
explanation: Salvation is God's free gift. “For it is by grace you have been saved through faith” (Ephesians 2:8, BSB)

content: In Ephesians, Paul says being saved by grace is not from ourselves, but is what?
explanation: We cannot earn it. “and this not from yourselves; it is the gift of God” (Ephesians 2:8, BSB)

content: In Ephesians, Paul says we are not saved by works, so that no one can do what?
explanation: All the credit goes to God. “not by works, so that no one can boast.” (Ephesians 2:9, BSB)

content: In Ephesians, Paul says God, because of His great love, is rich in what?
explanation: He made us alive with Christ. “But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy” (Ephesians 2:4, BSB)

content: In Ephesians, Paul says God made us alive with Christ even when we were what?
explanation: God gives life to the lost. “made us alive with Christ even when we were dead in our trespasses.” (Ephesians 2:5, BSB)

content: In Ephesians, Paul says we are God's workmanship, created in Christ to do what?
explanation: Good works follow being saved. “For we are God’s workmanship, created in Christ Jesus to do good works” (Ephesians 2:10, BSB)

content: In Ephesians, Paul says believers are no longer strangers, but members of whose household?
explanation: Grace brings us into God's family. “but fellow citizens with the saints and members of God’s household” (Ephesians 2:19, BSB)

content: In Ephesians, what does Paul tell believers to put on to stand against the devil?
explanation: God gives us what we need to stand. “Put on the full armor of God, so that you can make your stand against the devil’s schemes.” (Ephesians 6:11, BSB)

content: In the armor of God, what is the belt buckled around the waist?
explanation: Truth holds everything together. “with the belt of truth buckled around your waist” (Ephesians 6:14, BSB)

content: In the armor of God, what is the breastplate?
explanation: It guards the heart. “with the breastplate of righteousness arrayed” (Ephesians 6:14, BSB)

content: In the armor of God, which shield puts out the evil one's flaming arrows?
explanation: Faith trusts God's promises. “take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.” (Ephesians 6:16, BSB)

content: In the armor of God, what is the helmet?
explanation: It protects the mind. “And take the helmet of salvation” (Ephesians 6:17, BSB)

content: In the armor of God, what is the sword of the Spirit?
explanation: God's word is our weapon. “and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.” (Ephesians 6:17, BSB)

content: In the armor of God, what are our feet fitted with?
explanation: We are ready to share good news. “and with your feet fitted with the readiness of the gospel of peace.” (Ephesians 6:15, BSB)

content: When Paul describes the armor of God, he says our struggle is not against what?
explanation: The real battle is spiritual. “For our struggle is not against flesh and blood” (Ephesians 6:12, BSB)

content: In Ephesians, Paul says to be strong in what?
explanation: Our strength comes from God. “Finally, be strong in the Lord and in His mighty power.” (Ephesians 6:10, BSB)

content: After describing God's armor, how often does Paul tell believers to pray in the Spirit?
explanation: Prayer keeps us alert. “Pray in the Spirit at all times, with every kind of prayer and petition.” (Ephesians 6:18, BSB)

content: In Ephesians, Paul says to forgive each other just as who forgave you?
explanation: Be kind and tenderhearted. “forgiving each other just as in Christ God forgave you.” (Ephesians 4:32, BSB)

content: In Ephesians, Paul says do not let what set upon your anger?
explanation: Deal with anger quickly. “Do not let the sun set upon your anger” (Ephesians 4:26, BSB)

content: In Ephesians, what does Paul tell children to do?
explanation: This is right in the Lord. “Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.” (Ephesians 6:1, BSB)

content: In Ephesians, Paul calls “Honor your father and mother” the first commandment with what?
explanation: It promises a good life. “(which is the first commandment with a promise)” (Ephesians 6:2, BSB)

content: In Ephesians, Paul tells believers to be imitators of whom?
explanation: As beloved children. “Be imitators of God, therefore, as beloved children” (Ephesians 5:1, BSB)

content: In Ephesians, who is called the cornerstone of God's household?
explanation: The church is built on Him. “with Christ Jesus Himself as the cornerstone.” (Ephesians 2:20, BSB)

content: In Ephesians, Paul lists one Lord, one faith, and one what?
explanation: Believers are united. “one Lord, one faith, one baptism” (Ephesians 4:5, BSB)

content: To the saints in which city did Paul write the letter of Ephesians?
explanation: He was an apostle by God's will. “To the saints in Ephesus, the faithful in Christ Jesus” (Ephesians 1:1, BSB)

content: In Ephesians, whom did Paul send to tell the believers all his news?
explanation: He was a faithful servant. “Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will tell you everything” (Ephesians 6:21, BSB)

content: In Ephesians, Paul says God is able to do much more than all we what?
explanation: His power works within us. “to do so much more than all we ask or imagine” (Ephesians 3:20, BSB)

content: In Ephesians, Paul says speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and what?
explanation: Make music to the Lord in your hearts. “Speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs.” (Ephesians 5:19, BSB)

content: In Ephesians, Paul urges believers to preserve the unity of the Spirit through the bond of what?
explanation: Unity takes effort and love. “to preserve the unity of the Spirit through the bond of peace.” (Ephesians 4:3, BSB)
